standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-not-.npc: I'm here to guard this ship from any scurvy dogs darin' to loot her cargo.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-not-.player: How did your ship end up here?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-not-.npc: Me hearties and I were enjoying a bit o' grog when we espied a group of landlubbers fightin' on the shore. 'Twas such an exciting battle that our navigator forgot to watch for the rocks.
Now we've run aground, as ye can see.

options.text: Where's the rest of your crew?

steps.player: Where's the rest of your crew?

steps.npc: They're searchin' for booty at that temple to the west.

steps.player: Will they return to the ship?

steps.npc: They best do! That scurvy lot keep fillin' their lockers with loot and sneakin' off without swappin' places!

options.text: Do you really want to go to the temple?

steps.player: Do you really want to go to the temple? I've heard the mages there have some really annoying spells.

steps.npc: Nothin' we can't handle! We've a way of stoppin' their tricksy teleports.

steps.player: How can a group of mindless zombies invent a counter to magic?

steps.npc: What we lack in brains, we make up for in gold! We found us a landlubber willin' to share their knowledge... for a price.
They wrote us down a spell on some magic scrolls. All we 'ave to do is read one, and then we're properly anchored! Those mages can't teleport us anywhere!

steps.player: Wow, I'm actually impressed. Do you think your friends at the temple will lend me one?

steps.npc: Naw, they're too busy fightin' to talk to the likes of ye. Besides, we stash all our spare scrolls in these lockers for safekeepin'.

steps.player: Can I take a scroll from a locker, then?

steps.npc: Ye'll need a key for that, matey! One of the crew should 'ave one.
And when ye see 'em, tell 'em it's their turn to keep watch!
There be plenty o' loot in them lockers, matey. Don't expect to find a scroll right away.

steps.player: Thanks. I'd say 'see you around', but I sort of hope I don't.

steps.npc: Aye, the feelin's mutual.

steps.player: Goodbye, I hope your crew comes back soon.

steps.npc: Arr, me too matey.
Bye, matey.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Arr, I've still not seen any of my crew.
